Risk: Misclassification under adversarial perturbations in image classifiers
Problem analysis: Small L∞-bounded perturbations cause high error rates in classifiers
Theoretical insight: PGD-based adversarial training yields robustness to many first-order attacks
Design rationale: Mixed-minibatch PGD adversarial training combining clean and adversarial samples
Implementation mechanism: Noisy PGD attack generator for training adversarial examples
Validation evidence: ImageNet M-PGD white-box Top-1 accuracy 3.9% baseline
Intervention: Conduct mixed-minibatch PGD adversarial training at scale via distributed synchronous large-batch training
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1803.06373
